items.value: The School Council's topic:
To save more electricity, it is proposed to partially turn off the school's lights.
Disable a cooldown for all pressure plates.
Allow to our students to run, drink or stay after-hours in the halls in order to give the Principal's attention to more important matters.
Disable faculty's noisy plates to they stopped distracting students from their lessons.
Looks like our school needs a deep cleaning! Should we give overtime to Gotta Sweep?
Randomize absolutely all vending machines items.
Turn off all conveyor belts due to the absence of manufactured goods.
It seems like our school equipment is subject to frequent wear and tear! We need to restore broken Ziplines?
It seems our ventilation system can't cope with the stuffiness! Should we activate them for a while?
Should we allow students to walk through Faculty Super doors?
We turned off lights in some rooms!
We turned off a cooldown for all plates!
Everyone is free to: run, drink or stay after-hours!
Faculty's noisy plates are disabled now!
Gotta sweep, sweep, sweep!
Vending machines items were randomized!
We turned off all conveyor belts!
Ziplines were restored!
Ventilation is open!
Everyone is free to: walk through Faculty Super doors!
